# Images & design

Image generators and practical editors for social posts, book covers, diagrams, thumbnails, photos, and design experiments. Free art tools are strongest at drafts and iteration; always check whether the plan you used permits the kind of use you have in mind.

**Last verified:** October 22, 2026 · **20 tools**

[Back to the guide](../README.md) · [All categories](README.md) · [Safety checklist](../free-tier-safety.md)

> **Category tip:** A free image is not automatically free to sell. Commercial rights, model licenses, watermark rules, and public-gallery defaults differ by tool and by plan. For client or book work, read the license before you rely on the output, and keep a record of what you generated.

**Start here:** [Canva](#tool-canva) · [Microsoft Designer](#tool-microsoft-designer) · [Upscayl](#tool-upscayl)

## All 20 tools

<a id="tool-canva"></a>

### Canva

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free design editor with templates, stock elements, and a limited allowance of Magic AI features such as text generation, image generation, and background tools.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free Canva account with email or Google sign-in; no card. AI actions use a limited monthly allowance.
- **Limits:** AI uses are metered. Premium templates, brand kits, many background removals, higher-resolution exports, and advanced Magic tools are paid. Check content licenses for each asset.
- **Best for:** Beginner-friendly social graphics, slides, book promotion images, and quick visual projects.
- **Official link:** <https://www.canva.com>
- **Tags:** `design` `templates` `social-media` `beginner`

<a id="tool-microsoft-designer"></a>

### Microsoft Designer

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free AI image generation, editable designs, stickers, and templates through a Microsoft account, including everyday social and promotional layouts.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free Microsoft account; no card. Image boosts are capped.
- **Limits:** Image generation uses a capped boost system, after which generations are slower or restricted. Premium templates and some AI editing features need a paid plan.
- **Best for:** Fast, free promotional images and simple designs without a steep learning curve.
- **Official link:** <https://designer.microsoft.com>
- **Tags:** `design` `images` `templates` `microsoft`

<a id="tool-adobe-firefly"></a>

### Adobe Firefly

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** A monthly allowance of generative credits for text-to-image, generative fill, and selected editing features in Adobe's web tools.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free Adobe account; no card for the starter credit allowance. Paid plans add credits and features.
- **Limits:** Free credits are small and reset on a schedule. More credits, advanced models, video, and high-volume work are paid. Commercial use is governed by Adobe's terms and the model used.
- **Best for:** Light commercial design work where you value Adobe's content-credential approach and editing ecosystem.
- **Official link:** <https://firefly.adobe.com>
- **Tags:** `images` `editing` `commercial` `adobe`

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** A free Google Labs image generator with prompt suggestions and multiple style variations, available in supported countries.

<a id="tool-stable-diffusion-webui"></a>

### Stable Diffusion WebUI

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free, open-source browser interface for running Stable Diffusion image models locally with broad control over prompts, models, and extensions.
- **Sign-up notes:** Install from the official repository; no account or card. You supply the hardware and model downloads.
- **Limits:** Requires a capable GPU or patient CPU use, lots of disk space, and technical setup. Model licenses differ, and extensions can introduce security or quality risks. Nothing is hosted for you.
- **Best for:** Users who want deep control and no per-image service fees once local models are installed.
